items.headline: Microsoft Bug Undetected Since July Triggered Worldwide Outage
items.excerpt: The bug that crippled Microsoft Corp. productivity software last week had been lurking undetected in the company’s data centers since July.

items.headline: Jensen Huang Cannot Return to Nvidia
items.excerpt: Up till now the world has turned a blind eye to cronyism in the tech world. But it doesn’t have to anymore, and that’s why any efforts to restore Jensen Huang at Nvidia must be rejected, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Parmy Olson says. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: What Jensen Huang’s Exit Means for Nvidia
items.excerpt: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO after reports of marital infidelity including an affair with a woman the US reportedly suspects is a Chinese spy. His sudden exit leaves the AI giant with an interim CEO while throwing the broader AI market into uncertainty. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Apple to Let Users Face-Unlock iPhone Duo, Addressing Key Drawback
items.excerpt: Apple Inc. added the ability for iPhone Duo owners to unlock the device using facial recognition, addressing a key drawback of the company’s first foldable smartphone.

items.headline: Altman Says AI Industry ‘Will Be Fine’ After Huang’s Ouster
items.excerpt: OpenAI’s Sam Altman said he believes the artificial intelligence industry will weather the uncertainty prompted by the ousting of Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang last week.

items.headline: Fed's Warsh Says Staff Are Sketching Out AI Contingencies
items.excerpt: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh says staff at the US central bank have begun to sketch out contingencies for how the surging adoption of artificial intelligence might impact the world’s biggest economy. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Huang’s Ouster Fuels Doubts About Nvidia’s Support for Neoclouds
items.excerpt: Jensen Huang built Nvidia Corp. into the world’s most valuable company and channeled its financial heft into bankrolling neoclouds — a new class of businesses that stockpile chips and rent out computing power.

items.headline: Thoma Bravo’s Proofpoint Launches $2 Billion Debt Deal for M&A
items.excerpt: Thoma Bravo-backed Proofpoint Inc. has kicked off a near $2 billion debt sale to finance an acquisition and extend the maturity of a term loan, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.headline: Apple Taps 26-Year Veteran Corey Fugman to Run Pay, Card and Wallet Services
items.excerpt: Apple Inc. has tapped a 26-year company veteran as the new head of its payment service and digital wallet unit, a vital part of the iPhone maker’s services business.
